name: SBS
recent: SBS Nexus Berhad 近期公告主要是董事与大股东 Wong Chun Mun 及执行董事 Warren Cheng 在闭市期内的持股变动，两人多次在公开市场增持公司股份。此外，公司于 9 月底发布一项「其他」公告，但内文未提供具体细节。
notable: 董事总经理兼首席执行官 Wong Chun Mun 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日至 12 日期间多次增持公司股份。
执行董事兼首席运营官 Warren Cheng 于 2026 年 11 月 2 日至 10 日期间多次增持公司股份。

recent_en: SBS Nexus Berhad's recent announcements mainly relate to changes in the interests of Director and substantial shareholder Wong Chun Mun and Executive Director Warren Cheng during the closed period, with both acquiring shares in the open market on multiple occasions. The company also issued an 'OTHERS' announcement in late September, but no details were provided in the text.
notable_en: Managing Director/CEO Wong Chun Mun acquired shares of the company multiple times between 5 and 12 November 2026.
Executive Director/COO Warren Cheng acquired shares of the company multiple times between 2 and 10 November 2026.
